niro_2833dd4b30.text:
Come back. Let me take you out of here.
We used to trust each other.

niro_628d72a58b.text:
Miro. It's Niro. You are my brother.
You kept order; I kept the ward. I thought we were helping people.

niro_a05a866c01.text:
I became a doctor to help people. These wards are all I know.
If the seals fail, prisoners and Keepers both get sick.

niro_59ba31d404.text:
They told me there was no other way. I need to believe
we can still make this work.

niro_6c60638bd7.text: Put it down, Miro. You were never supposed to wake up this far down.

niro_367b7cef9e.text:
You were never sick. Exposure after exposure, nothing.
You are immune, Miro. You always were.

niro_99d8018a0e.text:
The tower made the sickness. They called it progress.
When it got out, they told me you were our only chance.

niro_f037a8ec67.text:
I kept you alive. I thought if I understood why, I could save everyone.
They said you'd destroy the cure if you got out. I believed them.

niro_700e506fe0.text: I believed keeping you here was love.

niro_5b185efc56.text:
Stay. Help me finish it. If all of this was for nothing...
I do not know who I have been.

niro_737778b375.text:
The sick are still real. Whatever the tower did...
do not forget them.

niro_a8901c4c6e.text:
I wanted a life where I could keep you safe.
They gave me a title, and I mistook it for a choice.

niro_a066a9621c.text:
(He looks at the lab, not at Miro.)
Someone has to stay with them. Go.

niro_e0ae8640eb.text:
Every time you raise that thing, they write it down.
Dangerous. Unstable. You're proving them right.

niro_b711c20d25.text:
This floor holds everything up. Me included.
Stop, Miro.

niro_4e9c139eb2.text: You don't understand what's down there.

niro_fb40ed3dde.text: Then come to the bottom. See what you're breaking.

niro_99f4f44da6.text: Can you hear me? Good. I hate this thing too. It makes me sound like them.

niro_9f2a0012ca.text: You're running in circles, Miro. I drew the circles.

niro_6cdd67e828.text: Every Keeper you put to sleep is a report I write tonight. In my handwriting.

niro_cb07e495f3.text: They're not hunting you. They're collecting you. There's a difference. I made sure of it.

niro_98c21d71f0.text: Slow down. Your heart rate's on my screen. You'll tear something I stitched.

niro_f19602b658.text: Nobody leaves this tower, Miro. Not the sick. Not the Keepers. Not me.

niro_24e11665ef.text: Down is the wrong way. Down is where I keep the truth. Come and look, then.

niro_529c309714.text: Nobody even knows your face anymore. Come home before they do.

niro_68ca6d623e.text: You walked through my whole tower and nobody saw you. You could have just left.

niro_b492b2b223.text: They're calling you a monster. Stop proving them right.

niro_aafe65c4a0.text: How many, Miro? How many before you're what they said?

niro_3bf8d928f0.text: I can hear the alarms from here. Please stop.

niro_925f70ceb1.text: You used to. Stay there. Let me help you.

niro_342a4156c2.text:
Miro. Please. Don't go any lower.
You took his life. Was that necessary?

niro_7d3065558e.text:
Miro. Please. Don't go any lower.
You got past him without killing. There is still time to stop.

pa_ab939b6eb9.text: Prisoner M-07 unaccounted for. Search your sections.

pa_e6a4edf388.text: Prisoner M-07 is armed and has killed Keepers. Lethal force authorised.

pa_d5ab4b39ec.text: Prisoner M-07 is the bomber. All units...

judas_189b7a2890.text: Awake again. Keep it down, traitor.

judas_184e52bbfd.text:
Depends. Cell 04 gave me his boots. Cell 09 gave me his ration card.
What have you got?

judas_4780e8fe6a.text:
Then I'm not looking. (He turns away, coughing.)
The tower doesn't pay me enough to care.

dane_symptoms_1.text: Another prisoner coughing. Did the transfer orders say where they go?

lusk_symptoms_2.text: Only the ward number. Nobody tells us what happens after that.

dane_symptoms_3.text: Keep your voice down. I'll check the passage. You watch the stairs.

lusk_treason_1.text: The one from Cell 07. They say he opened a door he shouldn't have.

dane_treason_2.text: I heard he refused an order. Same thing, up here.

dane_branch_missing_0.text: Someone let him out. Somebody on our shift.

lusk_branch_missing_1.text: Check the lockers again. He can't just vanish.

dane_branch_hunted_0.text: He killed Rowan. Rowan had a daughter.

lusk_branch_hunted_1.text: Stay in pairs. Don't let him get close.

dane_verse_ghost_0_0.text: Chaplain pinned a verse over the stairs. 'Whither shall I flee from thy presence?' Psalm 139.

lusk_verse_ghost_0_1.text: Somebody should tell him. Because M-07 found somewhere.

dane_verse_blackhat_0_0.text: Luke 8. 'Nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest.'

lusk_verse_blackhat_0_1.text: Tell that to the cameras. Half of them went dark and nobody signed for it.

dane_verse_defiant_0_0.text: 'All they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.' Matthew 26. Remember it.

lusk_verse_defiant_0_1.text: He took a shank, not a sword. And he's not the one perishing.

dane_verse_survivor_0_0.text: 'Troubled on every side, yet not distressed. Cast down, but not destroyed.'

lusk_verse_survivor_0_1.text: Second Corinthians. You read that about yourself, or about him?

dane_verse_seeker_0_0.text: 'Seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened.' Matthew 7.

lusk_verse_seeker_0_1.text: Not in here it won't. They changed the locks on the records room.

dane_verse_neutral_0_0.text: 'Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them.' Hebrews 13.

lusk_verse_neutral_0_1.text: We are bound with them. Same air, same cough.

oren_password_1.text: I need to log into this terminal. What was the password again?

dov_password_2.text: Root. All lowercase. R, O, O, T. Same as last shift.

oren_password_3.text: Right. Once you're in, you can disable both checkpoint cameras.

dov_password_4.text: I'll watch the far passage. Don't leave the terminal open.

oren_branch_missing_0.text: Someone let him out. Somebody on our shift.

dov_branch_missing_1.text: Check the lockers again. He can't just vanish.

oren_branch_hunted_0.text: He killed Rowan. Rowan had a daughter.

dov_branch_hunted_1.text: Stay in pairs. Don't let him get close.

oren_verse_ghost_1_0.text: 'The darkness hideth not from thee.' My mother used to say that at bedtime.

dov_verse_ghost_1_1.text: Then she never worked a night shift in this place. Check the vents.

oren_verse_blackhat_1_0.text: 'Men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.' John 3.

dov_verse_blackhat_1_1.text: Is that about him or about the people who switched the cameras off?

oren_verse_defiant_1_0.text: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth. That's in there too, you know.

dov_verse_defiant_1_1.text: 'Vengeance is mine, saith the Lord.' Not yours. Not his either.

oren_verse_survivor_1_0.text: 'Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death...'

dov_verse_survivor_1_1.text: He walked through two alarms and a firing line. Fear no evil, apparently.

oren_verse_seeker_1_0.text: 'Ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.'

dov_verse_seeker_1_1.text: Keep that one off the walls. The Ward doesn't like truth on the walls.

oren_verse_neutral_1_0.text: Isaiah 61. 'To proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison.'

dov_verse_neutral_1_1.text: Don't read that one out loud down here.

tomas_ward_1.text: They sealed the ward again. Even our keys won't open that gate.

ivar_ward_2.text: Read the experiment records first. Then use the manual release.

tomas_ward_3.text: Fine. I'm turning back to the passage. I don't like standing here.

tomas_branch_missing_0.text: Someone let him out. Somebody on our shift.

ivar_branch_missing_1.text: Check the lockers again. He can't just vanish.

tomas_branch_hunted_0.text: He killed Rowan. Rowan had a daughter.

ivar_branch_hunted_1.text: Stay in pairs. Don't let him get close.

tomas_verse_ghost_0_0.text: Chaplain pinned a verse over the stairs. 'Whither shall I flee from thy presence?' Psalm 139.

ivar_verse_ghost_0_1.text: Somebody should tell him. Because M-07 found somewhere.

tomas_verse_blackhat_0_0.text: Luke 8. 'Nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest.'

ivar_verse_blackhat_0_1.text: Tell that to the cameras. Half of them went dark and nobody signed for it.

tomas_verse_defiant_0_0.text: 'All they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.' Matthew 26. Remember it.

ivar_verse_defiant_0_1.text: He took a shank, not a sword. And he's not the one perishing.

tomas_verse_survivor_0_0.text: 'Troubled on every side, yet not distressed. Cast down, but not destroyed.'

ivar_verse_survivor_0_1.text: Second Corinthians. You read that about yourself, or about him?

tomas_verse_seeker_0_0.text: 'Seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened.' Matthew 7.

ivar_verse_seeker_0_1.text: Not in here it won't. They changed the locks on the records room.

tomas_verse_neutral_0_0.text: 'Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them.' Hebrews 13.

ivar_verse_neutral_0_1.text: We are bound with them. Same air, same cough.

judas_alert.text: Back in your cell. We had a deal.

judas_body.text: Who saw this? Tell me who saw.

judas_idle_1.text: I don't run a charity. The rate went up.

judas_idle_2.text: Keep the key in the inside pocket. Trust nobody.

rowan_alert.text: Time out! You're not supposed to be playing!

rowan_body.text: Come on. Say I lose. Say something.

rowan_idle_1.text: Four laps. If I beat my record I get absolutely nothing.

rowan_idle_2.text: I'll race my shadow. It cheats on the corners.

ivo_alert.text: Prisoner out of bounds. Stop at the next line.

ivo_body.text: Mark the time. Nobody move the body.

ivo_idle_1.text: Same boot prints as yesterday. Different direction.

ivo_idle_2.text: A clean report starts with the things you can't explain.

bram_alert.text: The sign says stay inside. That's you, right?

bram_body.text: It says sleeping quarters upstairs. This can't be right.

bram_idle_1.text: The arrow points down, but someone hung it upside down.

bram_idle_2.text: I'd read the handbook if I knew which end to start.

alden_alert.text: Stop there. Are you hurt, or are you running?

alden_body.text: Get a cloth. No, a clean one. Hurry.

alden_idle_1.text: Three beds on the transfer sheet. Only two blankets.

alden_idle_2.text: I should have asked where they took the coughing one.

corin_alert.text: And for my next trick... wait, where did you come from?

corin_body.text: That's blood. I can't make that disappear.

corin_idle_1.text: Coin in this hand. No, the other hand. Ruined it again.

corin_idle_2.text: The trick is to look at the audience. The rats never look back.

dane_alert.text: Hands off the rail. Face the wall.

dane_body.text: Seal the corridor. I don't want a boot through this scene.

dane_idle_1.text: Rust starts where you stop looking.

dane_idle_2.text: Someone used my polishing rag to wipe a plate.

ellis_alert.text: I'd let it slide, but that's how they dock my pay.

ellis_body.text: He was owed two weeks. Someone needs to tell his family.

ellis_idle_1.text: The uniform is free. They take it out of your pay.

ellis_idle_2.text: If we're all essential, how come none of us gets a chair?

garrow_alert.text: Hold on. Do I blow the whistle before I shout?

garrow_body.text: Don't touch him. Unless the rule says touch him first.

garrow_idle_1.text: No running on wet stairs. What about running up them?

garrow_idle_2.text: Fire drill on Thursday. Hope the fire knows.

hollis_alert.text: Stop. Please don't make me raise the alarm.

hollis_body.text: He had a letter in his pocket. It never got sent.

hollis_idle_1.text: If I close my eyes this smells almost like home. Almost.

hollis_idle_2.text: I forgot what bread sounds like when you cut the crust.

jory_alert.text: An escape. That's a new square on my card.

jory_body.text: No. Cross that one off. I never wanted to see it.

jory_idle_1.text: Leak in the laundry, rat in the oats. Two more and I win.

jory_idle_2.text: My prize for a perfect shift is another shift.

kell_alert.text: Heel down. Face front. That's an order.

kell_body.text: One down. Form up before we lose another.

kell_idle_1.text: Left, right. If the floor can keep time, so can you.

kell_idle_2.text: One more step out of time and I'll march the stairs myself.

lusk_alert.text: I caught three like you last week! Wait up!

lusk_body.text: I said I'd keep him safe. I really said that.

lusk_idle_1.text: The beast was this big. Bigger when I tell it upstairs.

lusk_idle_2.text: I could make captain if they'd just ask about my record.

marek_alert.text: Breach on this deck. Stand fast.

marek_body.text: Close both ends of the passage. Nobody else goes down.

marek_idle_1.text: Every door is a bulkhead if you do your job.

marek_idle_2.text: I miss a floor that moves for a reason.

oren_alert.text: And now, the escape artist. Hold the applause.

oren_body.text: No clever title for this one. Somebody get help.

oren_idle_1.text: A study in wet socks, by Keeper Oren.

oren_idle_2.text: Portrait of a man waiting for a bell that hates him.

pavel_alert.text: Unscheduled movement. Show me your pass.

pavel_body.text: This wasn't a fall. Look at the angle.

pavel_idle_1.text: If the latch needs a kick, the latch is broken.

pavel_idle_2.text: I put the good screws in a separate tin. Someone mixed them.

silas_alert.text: Visitors go the other way. Actually, stay right there.

silas_body.text: I show people this landing. I can't show them this.

silas_idle_1.text: On your left, the tower's second most disappointing window.

silas_idle_2.text: Questions at the end, please. There is no end.

teodor_alert.text: Right. Stop. Or should I get someone? Stop anyway.

teodor_body.text: I can't decide who to call. Somebody decide for me.

teodor_idle_1.text: If I start with the bottom step, I won't get the top one wrong.

teodor_idle_2.text: I've been weighing lunch since breakfast.

ansel_alert.text: Stop. I won't let it happen on my watch again.

ansel_body.text: Not again. I was here this time. I was right here.

ansel_idle_1.text: I wrote the report twice. Neither version said why I left.

ansel_idle_2.text: I don't trade shifts. I don't owe anyone another favor.

brin_alert.text: I knew the creaking stair meant trouble. Halt!

brin_body.text: I joked about bad luck. I didn't mean this.

brin_idle_1.text: A bird hit the window. Probably wants a transfer.

brin_idle_2.text: If the candle goes out, that's my excuse to go home.

cato_alert.text: Step away from the shelves. Let me see your hands.

cato_body.text: I know him. He let me finish the chapter.

cato_idle_1.text: The best books have the dullest labels.

cato_idle_2.text: If I file it under inventory, nobody opens it.

dov_alert.text: You're not on the list. Please don't ask to see it.

dov_body.text: I can't joke my way past this. Get the captain.

dov_idle_1.text: I practiced saying access denied in the mirror.

dov_idle_2.text: The terminal doesn't laugh either. That's reassuring.

tomas_alert.text: Stay out of the ward. That's for your sake too.

tomas_body.text: Get the medic. Don't let them put him on the list.

tomas_idle_1.text: Names go in the ledger. Numbers come back out.

tomas_idle_2.text: The worst part is how quiet the doors are.

ulric_alert.text: Intruder in the ward. Keep the exits sealed.

ulric_body.text: First secure the door. Then we'll count our own.

ulric_idle_1.text: The lock is only as good as the Keeper checking it.

ulric_idle_2.text: I listen for the click. Other people just pull the handle.

venn_alert.text: That wasn't the pipes. Hey, you there!

venn_body.text: Wake up. Even the boiler makes more noise than you.

venn_idle_1.text: Morning, valve three. You sound dreadful today.

venn_idle_2.text: One knock means steam. Two knocks means Venn needs lunch.

wren_alert.text: Escaping without a discharge form? Stop right there.

wren_body.text: He won't need a discharge form. Someone get a doctor.

wren_idle_1.text: They sent me three forms and one bandage.

wren_idle_2.text: The medicine cabinet has more locks than medicine.

edric_alert.text: The door is under observation. Wait, so are you!

edric_body.text: Is this what the records meant by critical? Help!

edric_idle_1.text: It says isolate the chamber. I haven't spoken to it all day.

edric_idle_2.text: I was told to take inventory. Nobody said where to take it.

fane_alert.text: Stop at the red stripe. Nothing crosses it.

fane_body.text: Find the first aid tin. I checked it this morning.

fane_idle_1.text: Two lanterns work. Which means we have one spare.

fane_idle_2.text: If the water stops, open the barrel before the taps run dry.

gil_alert.text: I had a rhyme for that. Never mind. Stop!

gil_body.text: No song for this. Go get someone.

gil_idle_1.text: Ward door, stone floor. That's not enough for a chorus.

gil_idle_2.text: Someone told me to sing under my breath. I'm trying.

hask_alert.text: Hold position. State your name and destination.

hask_body.text: Mark his post uncovered. I'll take it until relief.

hask_idle_1.text: I brief the next shift even when it's the same shift.

hask_idle_2.text: Don't say all clear unless you've looked.

ivar_alert.text: Well, you're the first interesting thing all night. Halt.

ivar_body.text: Easy now. I'll stay with you. Somebody fetch help.

ivar_idle_1.text: I keep a list of things worse than this job. It's short.

ivar_idle_2.text: They say the lower you go, the closer you are to promotion.

yorick_alert.text: Against the wall. Not the one that's cracking.

yorick_body.text: Get away from the stonework. I need a clear path.

yorick_idle_1.text: You hear that? The whole tower settling on our heads.

yorick_idle_2.text: I keep one boot pointed at the exit.

zane_alert.text: I'll get him! Wait, which way did he go?

zane_body.text: I said follow me. I shouldn't have said that.

zane_idle_1.text: I volunteered for the basement. What a tremendous decision.

zane_idle_2.text: Bet I can make it back before anybody notices I left.

arlen_alert.text: Don't push your luck. Set it down and back away.

arlen_body.text: Cover me. I'm going to bring him out.

arlen_idle_1.text: Know the person behind you. That's who brings you home.

arlen_idle_2.text: I count heads at the top and the bottom.

beck_alert.text: The doctor's expecting you. I'm not letting you pass.

beck_body.text: Where's the doctor when it's one of us?

beck_idle_1.text: He said this post was quiet. Maybe he meant afterward.

beck_idle_2.text: When the boss whispers, the rest of us run.

cass_alert.text: Over there! I mean here! Don't move!

cass_body.text: I went the wrong way. I should have been here.

cass_idle_1.text: Tie a string to the left glove. Now where's the string?

cass_idle_2.text: They told me to cover the rear. Rear of what?

doran_alert.voice_name: Knox Dark - Serious, Deep, and Steady
doran_alert.text: Stay put. I'm not wasting a second round.

doran_body.voice_name: Knox Dark - Serious, Deep, and Steady
doran_body.text: We're short a Keeper. Close ranks and make it count.

doran_idle_1.voice_name: Knox Dark - Serious, Deep, and Steady
doran_idle_1.text: They issue one spare for everything except people.

doran_idle_2.voice_name: Knox Dark - Serious, Deep, and Steady
doran_idle_2.text: If anyone asks, there were six rounds in that box.

elm_alert.text: Drop it! I mean stop! I wasn't taking anything.

elm_body.text: I found his badge. I didn't think I'd find him too.

elm_idle_1.text: This copper will make a good ring if I can bend it.

elm_idle_2.text: Don't throw away a good spring just because it's sprung.

fenn_alert.text: Footsteps. Stop before you cross that beam.

fenn_body.text: I heard a body fall. It wasn't the ceiling.

fenn_idle_1.text: A dry crack is stone. A wet one means get out.

fenn_idle_2.text: The little sounds matter before the big ones start.

pike_alert.text: Peace. Put that down and nobody needs to bleed.

pike_body.text: Rest now. I'll stay until they come.

pike_idle_1.text: Read it slowly. You miss the good part if you rush.

pike_idle_2.text: A bell can call you to more than a shift.

moss_alert.text: Are you looking for the stairs? Wait, that's a weapon.

moss_body.text: Is he hurt? I can fetch someone. Who do I fetch?

moss_idle_1.text: If we all share the bread, does the last man get the crust?

moss_idle_2.text: I can remember the verse if I remember what's for lunch.

tibb_alert.text: You picked a rotten time for a visit. Stop.

tibb_body.text: Come on, friend. I won't laugh if you get up.

tibb_idle_1.text: If heaven has a night shift, they can keep my place.

tibb_idle_2.text: I tease Pike because he keeps reading anyway.

hale_alert.text: Those prints were yours. End of the trail.

hale_body.text: This is his work. Nobody touch the ground around him.

hale_idle_1.text: Fresh dust on the hinge. Someone went through.

hale_idle_2.text: I don't need a face if I've got a trail.

rusk_alert.text: Caught you between posts. On your knees.

rusk_body.text: He slipped a checkpoint. Tighten the next one.

rusk_idle_1.text: If I get the arrest, I get out of booth duty.

rusk_idle_2.text: The trick is to wait where a runner stops to breathe.

soren_alert.text: Stop there. I have orders to fire this time.

soren_body.text: They said there'd be two of us. What do I do now?

soren_idle_1.text: Read the order again. My hands won't stop shaking.

soren_idle_2.text: They didn't tell me what he looked like until they shut the gate.

gideon_alert.text: Don't close the distance. Hands where I see them.

gideon_body.text: Move to cover. He didn't have a clear lane.

gideon_idle_1.text: Long hall, straight shot. If I can get my hands still.

gideon_idle_2.text: Someone keeps putting crates in the firing lanes.

fenwick_body.text: That's his last shift. At least write down when it ended.

fenwick_idle_1.text: I write the hours on my cuff. The ledger lies.

fenwick_idle_2.text: Don't call it voluntary if they lock the door behind us.

osric_alert.text: By order of the tower, you will stop. Now!

osric_body.text: Section nine. The one about casualties. I can't remember it.

osric_idle_1.text: Learn the rule before you need to break it.

osric_idle_2.text: They never put the hard cases on the exam.

leif_alert.text: Stay there. I've got the only clear way out.

leif_body.text: He's pinned. Bring a bar, not a gun.

leif_idle_1.text: Whoever framed this door didn't own a square.

leif_idle_2.text: I could fix the stair if they gave me a saw worth using.

quill_alert.text: First the paperwork, then the escape. Stop.

quill_body.text: I know his handwriting. I don't want this to be his last entry.

quill_idle_1.text: They swapped my pen for a pistol. The pen jammed less.

quill_idle_2.text: If I get out of this, I'm filing one very long complaint.

nash_alert.text: I heard you before I saw you. Don't move.

nash_body.text: The echo stopped. Get somebody down here.

nash_idle_1.text: Never answer the second echo. It isn't yours.

nash_idle_2.text: I count four footsteps when there should be three.

bastian_alert.text: Come out where I can see you. Slowly.

bastian_body.text: Get the doors open. I need room to move him.

bastian_idle_1.text: If the ceiling gets any lower, I'm taking the stairs.

bastian_idle_2.text: I can fight a man. I can't fight a locked room.

reeve_alert.text: You can wait. I've been waiting all night.

reeve_body.text: He was waiting for me to relieve him. I came too late.

reeve_idle_1.text: I had my boots off when they rang the bell.

reeve_idle_2.text: An extra shift is fine. It's the missing sleep I mind.

seth_alert.text: I don't want a fight. Just stop there.

seth_body.text: I'll get help. Someone stay with him.

seth_idle_1.text: Deliver the order and walk away. That's all I have to do.

seth_idle_2.text: I prefer notes. Nobody asks a note why it's shaking.

vale_alert.text: Eyes on me, prisoner. On me!

vale_body.text: Look at me. Listen to me. We can still save him.

vale_idle_1.text: Nobody remembers your orders if you say them quietly.

vale_idle_2.text: I learned to shout before I learned what to say.

pike_john316_1.text: Listen to this one. 'For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son...'

moss_john316_2.text: Only begotten. So he only had the one?

pike_john316_3.text: '...that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.' John 3:16.

tibb_john316_4.text: Everlasting life. Up here that's just an everlasting night shift.

pike_john316_6.text: Hush. Somebody in this tower should still believe in something.

tibb_john316_7.text: Then I believe the bell rings at six. Wake me when it does.

tarin_alert.text: Cut him off at the next landing.

ewan_alert.text: All right, good drill. Wait, this is real!

niall_alert.text: No one leaves this corridor. Halt!

ames_alert.text: You could have waited till I finished my supper. Stop!

tarin_body.text: I can reach the medic from here. Keep the stair clear.

ewan_body.text: This is real. Get someone down here.

niall_body.text: Seal the passage. Send a runner for help.

ames_body.text: Forget supper. Somebody get a doctor.

tarin_idle_1.text: The east stairs are faster if the door is open.

ewan_idle_1.text: I put my boots on for this. It had better be a drill.

niall_idle_1.text: If the watcher blinks twice, I check both doors.

ames_idle_1.text: I bring cold soup. It saves the tower the trouble.

tarin_idle_2.text: Thirty steps. Thirty-one if I miss the turn.

ewan_idle_2.text: Do they grade you on how fast you get to the wrong landing?

niall_idle_2.text: A blind post is still a post. I stand it.

ames_idle_2.text: The watcher always sees someone when I sit down.

miro_12078348eb.text: Then tell me why these doors are locked from the outside.

miro_c11902a1e1.text:
Another support. Another mark.
I wish I remembered why this feels familiar.

miro_49181b5b13.text: My name. Their uniform. I was one of them.

miro_2934942b7f.text: Then neither of us gets to look away.

miro_da3f0bbe50.text:
A Keeper would know where this belongs.
That is what frightens me.

miro_8900d0d1f3.text: They wrote it down as if that made it acceptable.

miro_9536076b33.text: Someone kept these records behind a locked door.

miro_96f18a6fec.text: The illness is real. That does not excuse this room.

miro_eba58b3036.text: Then help them leave. Stop asking them to suffer for this place.

miro_913b4b787e.text: Two charges. Set on the support, linked to the marks.

miro_c3be5c5746.text:
Five charges in the ward. The marks on the other floors
will carry the signal. There is no taking this back.

miro_dd91db2d1d.text:
A guitar on a stand, strings still in tune.
Mine. He kept it.

miro_94e383b3ed.text: My fingers already know where to go.

miro_652dd6edc7.text: The last support. The last mark.

miro_89cc079355.text: You. The voice in the remote. Niro.

miro_d187ac1dea.text: So you locked me up to take me apart.

miro_0b4f4d1d59.text: You let me believe I was dangerous.

miro_e12df9a120.text: You do not get to call it love and lock the door.

miro_8e32acb0a9.text: Then choose now. Come with me.

miro_cac7219035.text: The woods. Air that does not belong to them.

miro_a7fbc37e7f.text: Then don't look. That's all I need from you.

miro_787dcb6e97.text: Keep looking away. You're good at it.

miro_6b8f57073c.text: Then tell me who I was.

miro_da9d76f0fe.text: I'm not here. You never saw me.

miro_2ed604d0e8.text: Whoever did this to you will answer for it.

miro_ce543c4d73.text: If we trusted each other, you'd tell me why I'm here.

miro_0422ebfcdb.text: Then I know their doors, their cameras, their passwords.

miro_9575941319.text: Then I know exactly where it hurts.

miro_e8632c805a.text: I want to believe you, Niro.

miro_c1930781d6.text: Somebody has to remember them. I'll copy the numbers.

miro_e8cc375971.text: Every page of this goes down with the tower.

miro_ab83977026.text: Then don't follow me. You won't see me again until it's done.

miro_05448dfd43.text: Then stay out of my way.

miro_c544bb4c5f.text:
Stone. Iron. A name scratched into the bed: Miro.
Mine... I think. Nothing before this room.

miro_e8c98e0834.text: Is there anything you can do for me?

miro_3301fcd429.text:
His hands are shaking. The same marks as the others.
He's turned away. This might be my only chance.

miro_9cc602a048.text:
Wire. Powder. Two charges, hidden beneath the bed.
I've been building these in secret. My hands remember; I don't.

miro_8c3d9e3545.text:
A sharpened spoon. My blanket. Something I scratched
on the wrapping: 'Leave a mark. Keep going down.'

miro_3c18370461.text:
His key, while he faces away [E]. The spoon for close work [1, left click].
The charges [2]: right click to set one, left click to blow it.

miro_bea2244565.text:
This shape... I know it. My hands won't stop shaking.
One mark. Then down. Whoever wrote that wanted me to leave.

miro_75201f46de.text: You know my name. Do I know you?

miro_dfdde87801.text:
That voice should mean something. It hurts that it doesn't.
I can't stay here.

miro_72963738cf.text: The cameras went dark. The checkpoint is blind now.

thought_1_wake.text: One room. One way out. Start with what I can reach.

thought_1_chords.text: My fingers keep finding chord shapes. I don't remember learning them.

thought_1_below.text: He is coughing too. A uniform does not keep the sickness out.

thought_2_entry.text: They call this protection. Why do the locks face inward?

thought_2_ledger.text: No symptoms. No hearing. A name on a list is enough.

thought_3_entry.text: Every door trusts an order. Maybe I can give it a different one.

thought_3_hack.text: Root access. Their rules are only instructions someone wrote.

thought_3_rank.text: I wore their uniform. Was I dangerous then, or only when I stopped obeying?

thought_4_entry.text: The deeper I go, the less this place looks like a shelter.

thought_4_records.text: They kept counting results after they stopped counting people.

thought_4_charges.text: My hands are steady now. That does not make this easy.

thought_5_entry.text: The last door. I wanted the truth. I am afraid of what it will ask of me.

thought_5_truth.text: I am not their disease. I am not their cure to own.

thought_5_loss.text: He chose the tower again. Or he chose them. I can't tell which.

prisoner_23c4dfeaf0.text:
They took everyone in our room. Some of us were never sick.
I cannot stop shaking. Please... stand back.

miro_5ab3ed7a3e.text:
Below the cells, the coughing has names. Some doors hold the sick,
others anyone who stood beside them. Someone is coughing in the first cell. I should look.

miro_0badb157cd.text:
A checkpoint splits the tower. The uniforms feel familiar.
If I kill the controls, the cameras go blind. The records past it might explain me.

miro_b72d62ea60.text:
Sealed rooms. Observation windows. No names on the charts.
This was deliberate. The records first, then the seal, then the supports.

miro_d4e3048c4e.text:
At the bottom, everything else rests on what they keep here.
There's an office ahead. Something in there is humming.

miro_34ee5434a8.text: If nobody sees me, I'm only a rumour.

miro_932055b1cb.text: Maybe they were right about me.

mott_alert.text: Down here? Nobody comes down here. Except you, apparently.

pell_alert.text: Back in your cell! I said back!

mott_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

pell_body.text: He was coughing yesterday. Now he's not doing anything.

mott_idle_1.text: Bottom floor, bottom pay. Story of my life.

pell_idle_1.text: Another door, another cough. I stopped counting.

mott_idle_2.text: If that support cracks, I'm not the one explaining it.

pell_idle_2.text: They say it doesn't spread to us. They say a lot.

miro_d9b1bff7af.text: I smell a turret. Maybe I can use one of my C4 to destroy it.

crane_alert.text: Wrong floor, prisoner. Wrong life, too.

stroud_alert.text: You! Don't make me run, my knee's gone!

thane_alert.text: Halt! Halt, I think that's the word!

holt_alert.text: There you are. I bet Mott you'd come this way.

wick_alert.text: Get back in line! All of you, in line!

garth_alert.text: Oi! Visiting hours ended years ago!

crane_body.text: Somebody's going to make me write this up.

stroud_body.text: Oh, wonderful. Another one for the cart.

thane_body.text: Is he asleep? Tell me he's asleep.

holt_body.text: That's a week's wages I'm never collecting.

wick_body.text: Nobody touches him. Nobody touches anything.

garth_body.text: That's two this week. I'm keeping count.

crane_idle_1.text: I polish this floor and it just gets dirtier.

stroud_idle_1.text: Forty years and they still won't fix these stairs.

thane_idle_1.text: First week. Nobody told me about the coughing.

holt_idle_1.text: Two to one says the lamp goes out by midnight.

wick_idle_1.text: Gloves on. Gloves off. Gloves on again.

garth_idle_1.text: Cell nine asked for water again. Cell nine can wait.

crane_idle_2.text: Nobody visits the vault. That's the appeal.

stroud_idle_2.text: My knee says rain. My knee is always right.

thane_idle_2.text: If I stand very still maybe they'll forget I'm here.

holt_idle_2.text: I'd bet on the rats, honestly.

wick_idle_2.text: Wash your hands. I said wash them.

garth_idle_2.text: I used to know their names.

rook_alert.text: Up here? Clever. Not clever enough.

rook_body.text: Nobody falls off a ledge that quietly.

prisoner_98f58765c8.text: Don't. They'll only take more of us.

rook_idle_1.text: Best view in the tower. Worst pay.

rook_idle_2.text: They told me nobody climbs up here. So why am I up here?

judas_85258169f8.text: Careful. I can still hear you.

rhea_alert.text: Intruder! Hold the pose, I mean, hold still!

marta_alert.text: Hey! Put that down, you'll ruin my sourdough! I mean, stop!

odette_alert.text: Stop! You're the most interesting thing that's happened to me all year!

sunniva_alert.text: Not now! Eleven days left on my contract. Eleven!

calla_alert.text: Oh my, a real runaway! This is going straight into my podcast!

ingrid_alert.text: Intruder in the stacks! Quiet, please! Quiet!

noor_alert.text: Well, well. Look who's out past curfew. Shame about the handcuffs.

rhea_body.text: Oh no. Oh no, I should've stretched him out first.

marta_body.text: Somebody help him! Somebody get the first aid, and the flour!

odette_body.text: Of course. Even the dead ones stop to talk to me.

sunniva_body.text: Nope. Not signing the incident report. Eleven days.

calla_body.text: Okay, that's one for the true crime episode.

ingrid_body.text: Overdue. Everything about this is overdue.

noor_body.text: Aw. And I'd just gotten used to the company.

lusk_password_clue_2.text: Don't say it so loud. Honestly, though, it's the one password in this place I can remember.

rhea_idle_1.text: Roll the shoulders, long exhale. Even down here, breathe.

marta_idle_1.text: Starter needs feeding at six. The tower never lets me go home on time.

odette_idle_1.text: Four years on this floor and not one man who reads.

sunniva_idle_1.text: Eleven days. Then a goat farm in the north. Goats don't ask for passwords.

calla_idle_1.text: Episode forty. The case of the missing lunch money. Unsolved.

ingrid_idle_1.text: Keeper regulations, section nine, subsection four. Nobody ever reads it.

noor_idle_1.text: The night shift is long and the only company is Garth. Garth!

dane_password_clue.text: And nobody ever changed the service port login. Root, root. Anyone with a screwdriver could walk right in.

rhea_idle_2.text: Twelve hours standing. My core has never been stronger.

marta_idle_2.text: Cinnamon rolls on my day off. Ten tower guards, ten rolls.

odette_idle_2.text: Maybe the next prisoner will be handsome. A girl can dream.

sunniva_idle_2.text: I've already named the goats. Don't laugh.

calla_idle_2.text: Everyone here has a motive. Everyone. Even Garrow.

ingrid_idle_2.text: Alphabetical. Chronological. Then by whom I like less.

noor_idle_2.text: I wore the good boots today and nobody even looked.

miro_dc4d853c43.text: Then tell me why I'm here.

miro_ef87f3e106.text: I'll find my own way out.

niro_e4c9a32842.text: Not through a wall, Miro. Come back and I'll tell you everything.

niro_725f00c71b.text: There is no way out. Only down. Please, stop before it's too late.

miro_e1f48ce94b.text: Someone is coughing in the first cell. Just look before you run.

miro_d3a0af5920.text: Walk right a few steps from the stairs. The sick prisoner is in the first cell. [E]

miro_e79132eaba.text: Stand beside the coughing man, just right of where you came in, and press E.

miro_568d849f8c.text: The wall ahead has a gap at the bottom. Too low to walk through.

miro_230c09e68d.text: Hold Left Ctrl to crouch and crawl under the cell block wall.

miro_108595a39e.text: Crawl under the wall, then follow the voice at the bars on the far side. [E]

miro_630113369a.text: The ledger will be somewhere they keep paperwork. Lower down, in the barracks.

miro_8d2040c141.text: Ladder down, drop through the gap by the store room, then take the long ladder past the laundry.

miro_2541ef30b9.text: In the barracks, take the ladder at the far left, then climb onto the raised office. The ledger is on the desk. [E]

miro_fd8c24dbf8.text: The support is on the lowest floor. One more ladder.

miro_fcc77ed2a2.text: From the office, keep right to the last ladder, then head left along the bottom.

miro_2819c3cc5d.text: Crouch under the pillar's brace (Left Ctrl). The support is just past it. [E]

miro_93d9a97d8e.text: The stairs down are at the far left of the bottom floor.

miro_fc26edd4da.text: Keep going left past the support. [E] at the stair gate.

miro_5ca238030b.text: Bottom floor, far left wall. Press E at the stairs.

miro_ff5985f204.text: The terminal wants a password. The Keepers will have it written in their heads.

miro_df8a415c9a.text: Two Keepers stand talking on the floor below the vent. Hide close by and listen.

miro_db19da8c2f.text: Overhear the password on the second floor, then take the left ladder down. The terminal is just past the first shadow. [E]

miro_36e66f3379.text: The gate's open. The checkpoint stairs lead down to the security office.

miro_87005e6b69.text: Past the gate, take the ladder down, then go left to the raised office.

miro_9f37521e0a.text: Jump onto the raised office (double jump) and read the record on the desk. [E]

miro_740ca688ff.text: The voice is close now. Further down.

miro_2677afc533.text: Take the ladder at the far left of the office floor, then crouch under the pipes (Left Ctrl).

miro_4d3a1adf61.text: Past the pipes, the bars are in the middle of the floor. Stand at them. [E]

miro_97e18f214e.text: The support is on the lowest floor.

miro_5dd10f32fc.text: Right to the last ladder, then down and left.

miro_2fcd08c12e.text: Bottom floor, middle. Plant the sigil at the support. [E]

miro_a030fd4c5c.text: The stairs are at the far left.

miro_cd16f20b18.text: Records first. They're close to where I came in.

miro_c584d3d3a2.text: A few steps right of the stairs, by the first desk. [E]

miro_06f279e1aa.text: Walk right from the start. The experiment records are on the first desk. [E]

miro_d8da8d8b5f.text: The ward is sealed. There has to be a manual release somewhere above it.

miro_fe118ca581.text: Ladder down, then go left. Crouch under the window sill (Left Ctrl).

miro_6d4e1c7293.text: The release is on the raised gantry at the far left of the second floor. Double jump up. [E]

miro_24e59b46fa.text: The seal's open. The way down is past the ward doors.

miro_9586a36ffa.text: Ladder down at the left, go right through the opened seal, then the last ladder.

miro_5c20a55353.text: In containment, the evidence is just right of the chamber. [E]

miro_205823cfeb.text: He's watching from somewhere below the chamber.

miro_621cd04eb7.text: Take the ladder at the far left of containment.

miro_1c54b843ee.text: He's at the glass, a few steps right of the ladder. [E]

miro_40739ace63.text: Two charges on the ward support.

miro_ad1d0adaef.text: The support is right next to the glass.

miro_d0d1803899.text: Stand at the support beside the glass and press E (two charges).

miro_42d6c09f7f.text: Two more charges, on the lower support.

miro_8aa38278fa.text: Right to the last ladder, then down.

miro_52b77ee591.text: Bottom floor, near the ladder: the lower support. [E]

miro_b0b5dd2ddd.text: One mark left on this floor.

miro_7864ea5c19.text: Go left; crouch under the brace (Left Ctrl).

miro_c5feec08ab.text: Past the brace, the sigil support is on the left. [E]

miro_a05e65d189.text: Something is humming in the office ahead.

miro_080aa358e2.text: The office is to the right of where I came in. Something's on a stand.

miro_49715b35c4.text: Walk right into the office and press E at the guitar.

miro_6a565df6e5.text: One last mark, here at the very bottom.

miro_a29eafb672.text: The office support is right beside the guitar stand.

miro_708269f108.text: Stand at the support next to the guitar and press E.

miro_afa03780c9.text: They're coming down the stairs. Don't fight fair.

miro_df4e5a44cc.text: Strum the guitar close to them [6, left click]. On the beat it reaches further.

miro_307a2261fc.text: Select the guitar with 6 or G, get close, left click on the beat. Sleeping Keepers stay down.

miro_2181b4bd3f.text: He winds up before he rushes. Watch him, not the room.

miro_7672c16195.text: Jump or dodge [C] the rush, then hit him while he recovers.

miro_f7bcbec3dc.text: When he shows RECOVER, hit him: shank [1] or strum [6]. Dodge with C, then go again.

miro_34a19d06c7.text: He went down through a hatch.

miro_657677a68b.text: A hatch on this floor is open now.

miro_88ab69af02.text: Find the open hatch on this floor and drop through it.

miro_79ad2515e5.text: The bottom. Nowhere left for either of us.

miro_4147993af5.text: Same as before, faster. Dodge, then punish.

miro_2d4bc0b96c.text: Wait for RECOVER, hit him, back off. Repeat until he kneels.

miro_6678788bf0.text: Right side of the deepest floor.

miro_e8a082c9fb.text: Walk right to the opening and press E.

miro_dc17c787c4.text: Something is hidden under my bed. I can feel the shape of it.

miro_fea9ee6720.text: The bed is right here in the cell. Stand at it.

miro_cb871c0765.text: Walk to the bed in the cell and press E.

miro_b3cbbf2246.text: Judas has a key. Or the lock could just stop existing.

miro_5270e048f0.text: Wait for him to turn away and take the key [E]. Or set a charge on the lock: [2], right click.

miro_f8cc332af7.text: Stand behind Judas while he faces away and press E. Or select C4 [2], right click the lock, step back, left click.

miro_c1a145ec27.text: The gallery leads to a barred gate. Someone's waiting there.

miro_f4469fa57e.text: Go right along the gallery, past the cells, to the bars.

miro_d75a949047.text: Walk right to the barred gate and press E.

miro_fe98247564.text: 'Leave a mark.' Down where the tower holds itself up.

miro_93b15a3b63.text: Take the ladders down to the lowest floor.

miro_b888c9c798.text: On the bottom floor, find the support and press E.

miro_b09bd4ac61.text: Walk to the lower-right stair gate and press E.

moss_john316_8.text: Amen. Now, did anyone remember the service port password? I'm locked out again.

tibb_john316_9.text: Root. All lowercase. R, O, O, T. Same as every other shift.

pike_john316_10.text: Right. Once you're in, you can switch the corridor camera off. Not that I'd ever tell a prisoner.

moss_john316_11.text: I'll watch the stairs. And please, don't leave the port open.

dara_alert.text: Records are off limits! Step away from the screen!

vesna_alert.text: Hands off the port! That's maintenance property!

bryn_alert.text: Hey! That terminal is logged, you know!

corra_alert.text: Away from the checkpoint terminal! Now!

marl_alert.text: That log is classified! Stand down!

dara_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

vesna_body.text: Oh no. And I just got the port working.

ilse_body.text: Not at my terminal. Not on my shift.

bryn_body.text: I had one job: watch the screen.

odell_body.text: Nobody warned me about this posting.

corra_body.text: Somebody's going to have to explain this to the captain.

wren2_body.text: This is why I asked for a transfer.

fenna_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

marl_body.text: Not like this. Not by the terminal.

pru_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

dara_idle_1.text: The screen hums at night. I've started humming back.

vesna_idle_1.text: Root, root. If anyone asks, I never said that.

ilse_idle_1.text: I clean the screen every shift. No one notices.

bryn_idle_1.text: Every login is logged. Even mine.

odell_idle_1.text: Third floor smells like paper and bleach.

corra_idle_1.text: Checkpoint duty is the quietest post in the tower.

wren2_idle_1.text: Ward files. Ward files. Ward files.

fenna_idle_1.text: The sick ward files are the worst to guard.

marl_idle_1.text: Observation logs have the best handwriting.

pru_idle_1.text: I keep the ward terminal warm for the doctor.

dara_idle_2.text: Nobody reads the old files. That's the only reason I guard them.

vesna_idle_2.text: Two cables, one spare. That's my whole job.

ilse_idle_2.text: If the screen flickers, it's the ghost. I don't believe in ghosts.

bryn_idle_2.text: I've read the whole nine-page manual. Twice.

odell_idle_2.text: I log everyone who sits down. Except the dead ones.

corra_idle_2.text: If the cameras fail, I'm the backup. Lucky me.

wren2_idle_2.text: I read the first line of a record once. Never again.

fenna_idle_2.text: I memorise each log. It helps the night pass.

marl_idle_2.text: I read the cover pages and pretend I understand.

pru_idle_2.text: Nobody loves the ward terminal like I do.

niro_453e25d034.text: You move like you've done this before. You have, Miro. Come back before the tower remembers it for you.

niro_6361e5aa75.text: Whatever you find in the ward, brother, remember I tried to keep you out of it.

niro_b9d1a50808.text: You wore their uniform once. Every Keeper you drop fought beside you. Think about that.

niro_5925277f7d.text: Brother, the ward isn't what the records say. Whatever you do, don't burn it down before you've seen it.

miro_6ff8cd758c.text: I hacked the system and nobody has even realized.

miro_d4d8d0b634.text: A rumour can still bring a tower down. Even one who used to guard it.

miro_c7147254df.text: Quiet feet. Louder questions: what is the ward hiding?

miro_9be42ebbab.text: I wore their uniform once. Maybe that's why none of this feels new.

miro_744db1caf5.text: Every alarm I set off drowns out what the ward is trying to tell me.

niro_2f45c56d5d.text: You have the remote. Keep it close, and keep quiet.

niro_946d693f1a.text: If you go any lower, I can't protect you.

niro_00b98dd0e5.text: Now you know my name. Please, stop at the records.

niro_177eb18f68.text: Don't come down here, Miro. Please.

miro_b75ff64236.text: Someone is guiding me down. I should find out why.

miro_d57b5c2e12.text: Brother. The word feels true, and I hate that.

miro_030b513d8a.text: The seals, the supports. Everything rests on the floor below.

miro_28f9bd6a4c.text: Who is this? How do you know my name?

pa_e7d19a7056.text: Lights out. Cells sealed. Report every cough, including your own.

miro_679eb9a17f.text: You kept me in here, Niro. Was I sick too?

niro_0e64da7c5c.text: Someone who wants you out alive. Go down. The coughing started on the floors below, and it is spreading.

niro_186a17db35.text: From what they keep in the records. The sickness did not start in the cells, Miro.

niro_10cfbb6bd0.text: Find the personnel records on three. You will understand why I kept calling you back.

niro_6f905ba5e1.text: Not over a remote. Read what the ward kept, then decide what I am to you.

niro_775a58a83d.text: Everything rests on what we kept down there. I never lied about the sickness. I only never told you whose it was.

niro_62358dc4dd.text: You have the remote. Keep it close, and keep your hands clean.

niro_a51db6fbb9.text: You are leaving Keepers behind you. If you go any lower, I can't protect you.

niro_06513f5541.text: I watched every Keeper you dropped. Now you know my name. Please, stop at the records.

niro_9558bd1f82.text: You are making this harder, Miro. Don't come down here. Please.

miro_e824888902.text: They'll never know who did it. Maybe that's what freedom is.

miro_6f0a87cd99.text: They'll tell it their way. Let them.

garrick_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

garrick_idle_1.text: Everything above rests on this terminal. I keep it that way.

garrick_idle_2.text: Twenty years on the lowest floor. The roof has never fallen. Yet.

brandt_alert.text: Hold that corridor! Intruder in my section!

sable_alert.text: Found you. Your file says you'd run.

tolliver_alert.text: There. By the sealed door. Quietly now.

brandt_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

sable_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

tolliver_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

brandt_idle_1.text: Eyes front. The records do not guard themselves.

sable_idle_1.text: I have read every file on this floor. Yours was the dullest.

tolliver_idle_1.text: Sealed rooms hold their breath. I hold mine with them.

brandt_idle_2.text: If I hear one wrong footstep on three, someone runs laps.

sable_idle_2.text: They told me the filing was temporary. That was nine years ago.

tolliver_idle_2.text: I never raise my voice down here. The walls listen.

maren_alert.text: Oh no. Not on my shift. Stop right there.

maren_idle_1.text: Four nights without sleep. The ward lights start to hum.

maren_idle_2.text: If I close my eyes for one second, wake me. Or don't.

maren_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

voss_alert.text: Not on my corridor, friend. Stop!

voss_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

voss_idle_1.text: They gave me the quiet corridor. Quiet is when things go wrong.

voss_idle_2.text: If a cabinet moves on my shift, I'm filing it as a ghost.

miro_e2bf6d8526.text: They are looking for me upstairs. They're too late.

miro_48157340f9.text: They know my cell is empty. From here on, nobody is idle.

hobb_alert.text: Not on my last shift, you don't! Stop!

tamsin_alert.text: Come on, then. Show me what you've got.

corvin_alert.text: Intruder! Section four, on the double!

ilka_alert.text: I see you. Stop where you are.

dunmore_alert.text: I've seen worse than you. Halt!

perrin_alert.text: Well, I'll be. Hold it right there, friend!

yara_alert.text: Not in my corridor. Stop at once!

yara_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

hobb_idle_1.text: Eleven days to retirement. Do not make it twelve.

tamsin_idle_1.text: Fear is a habit. I never picked it up.

corvin_idle_1.text: Regulations are not suggestions. Remember that.

ilka_idle_1.text: Quiet floors are the loud ones. Remember that.

dunmore_idle_1.text: Back in the border war we had no ward. We had ditches.

perrin_idle_1.text: I miss the creek behind our house. This place has no creek.

yara_idle_1.text: I inspect every post twice. Then I inspect the inspectors.

hobb_idle_2.text: I have seen three prisoners escape. I mention none of them.

tamsin_idle_2.text: Try me on the laundry floor. Everyone else already has.

corvin_idle_2.text: Report every cough. Including your own. Especially your own.

ilka_idle_2.text: I keep the lowest post. Everything above rests on it.

dunmore_idle_2.text: Every corridor is the same corridor. Ask me how I know.

perrin_idle_2.text: They promised me a rotation home. That was two winters ago.

yara_idle_2.text: Straighten your belt. The tower is watching.

niro_a843c0d42e.text: You've read it by now. Miro, please... let me explain.

rocco_alert.text: Hey! Hey, you! Get back here!

rocco_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

rocco_idle_1.text: I bet the new guy ten bucks you wouldn't come this way.

rocco_idle_2.text: Second floor's the quiet floor. That's why I like it.

ormond_alert.text: Oi! Over here, everyone, he's on the ledge!

delphine_alert.text: There you are. I knew the tower would give you away.

ormond_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

delphine_body.text: A Keeper is down. Get help.

ormond_idle_1.text: Proper cold up here. I keep a flask under the ledge, mind.

delphine_idle_1.text: The tower keeps its order. I keep the tower's order.

ormond_idle_2.text: If the records go missing again, nobody tell the Commander I was chatting.

delphine_idle_2.text: Every prisoner believes they are the exception. None of them are.

miro_974156d051.text: The guitar's song stuns Keepers, turrets and even Niro. Strum it [Q, left click].

miro_3a81af8e89.text: Strum near them: Keepers sleep, turrets go dark, Niro staggers. On the beat it reaches further.

miro_ceb18e3929.text: Jump or dodge [C] the rush. A strum staggers him, or hit him while he recovers.

miro_4dc9072578.text: When he shows RECOVER, hit him: shank [1] or strum [Q]. Dodge with C, then go again.

miro_168d6586b6.text: He's sick, and he sells what's left of us.

miro_f078f4b892.text: A voice behind bars, asking me to trust it.

miro_d9f61d0206.text: He's terrified of me. Or of what they'll do if I'm seen here.

miro_6deb74570d.text: He wants me to come back. Back to what?

miro_84140f2214.text: If I was one of them, I know how this place works.

miro_30e8d75110.text: My brother. I want that to mean something.

miro_3c7f7d9dc3.text: Numbers where the names should be.

miro_3ce3c0e476.text: He's still asking me to stop. I'm still not stopping.

miro_2fb0b3dd47.text: Cameras. Maybe I can hack them.

miro_ab86089786.text: Maybe I can use my blanket to hide.

miro_4398f6ce5d.text: Maybe I can hack the cameras from a terminal, or use my MP3 nearby.

miro_c9da12d52b.text: Maybe I can hack that turret from a terminal, or use my MP3 nearby. C4 would work too.
